title: Biofloc Tilapia Farming
subtitle: A Replicable Model for Mandal-Level Income Generation
audience: Training Session — Mandal Officers, Andhra Pradesh
source_note: Based on CMFRI's Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (SCSP) initiative

blocks.label: Objective
blocks.text: Understand the model and plan replication in your mandal

sections.title: What is Biofloc Fish Farming?
sections.lead: Biofloc is a high-density fish farming method carried out in a controlled tank, where naturally occurring microbes convert fish waste into useful protein-rich nutrients — recycled back as feed.

items.title: Controlled environment
items.body: Farming happens in a single tank, not an open pond — usable even where no water body exists.

items.title: Waste becomes feed
items.body: Microbial 'floc' converts fish waste into nutrients, cutting feed cost and pollution.

items.title: High density, small space
items.body: Large yields from a compact footprint set up beside the household.

blocks.title: WHY IT SUITS RURAL HOUSEHOLDS
items: Set up next to the home

items.label: Scheduled Caste families formed one self-help group
GIFT tilapia fry stocked in a single tank
Biofloc tank built beside their homes

blocks.text: Fish reach 300–500 g in a single 8-month cycle.
A previously landless group now runs a viable micro-enterprise — proof that the model creates real, repeatable household income without access to open water.

sections.title: How the CMFRI Model Was Delivered

items.title: Identify & organise
items.body: Select eligible SC families and form a self-help group (SHG).

items.title: Build the unit
items.body: Install a 23,500 L biofloc tank next to households.

items.title: Stock the fry
items.body: Source GIFT tilapia fry from a certified hatchery (MPEDA).

items.title: Manage & monitor
items.body: Use a water-quality kit; CMFRI guides every growth phase.

items.title: Harvest & sell
items.body: Harvest at 300–500 g; earn ₹1.35 lakh per 8-month cycle.

blocks.text: CMFRI provided the tank, fry, feed and continuous technical guidance — the families provided labour and ownership.

sections.title: A Tool for Inclusive Rural Development

items.title: Reaches the landless
items.body: Designed under the Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan to benefit families without access to open water bodies.

items.title: Builds entrepreneurs
items.body: Families become small-scale business owners, not just beneficiaries — income stays in the community.

items.title: Environmentally sound
items.body: Closed, water-efficient system that recycles waste and avoids polluting local water sources.

items.title: Already proven & scaling
items.body: Running across Palakkad, Thrissur, Idukki, Kottayam & Kollam under CMFRI guidance.

groups.label: PHASE 1
groups.name: Survey & Select
tasks: Map SC/landless households lacking water-body access
Identify motivated families willing to form an SHG
Confirm space (~40 m²) and power/water near homes

groups.label: PHASE 2
groups.name: Mobilise & Fund
tasks: Tap SCSP / state fishery & NRLM convergence funds
Link group to a bank account for the cycle

groups.label: PHASE 3
groups.name: Set Up & Train
tasks: Install biofloc tank; supply fry, feed & test kit
Hands-on training on water quality & feeding
Source GIFT fry from a certified hatchery

groups.label: PHASE 4
groups.name: Run & Scale
tasks: Track growth, costs & sales as a demo unit
Use success to onboard more groups

sections.title: Key Factors for a Successful Replication

items.title: Convergence
items.body: Combine SCSP, fishery dept & NRLM schemes for capital and subsidy.

items.title: Technical hand-holding
items.body: Tie up with a research/KVK partner for continuous guidance like CMFRI.

items.title: Quality inputs
items.body: Use certified GIFT fry and reliable feed — the single biggest yield driver.

items.title: Water discipline
items.body: Daily water-quality monitoring decides survival and growth rates.

items.title: Group ownership
items.body: A genuine SHG with shared stake sustains the unit beyond officials.

items.title: Demo-led scaling
items.body: Run one model unit well, then let visible income recruit the next groups.

blocks.text: Pick one ward. Form one group. Build one tank. Prove the income — then replicate.
